```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;

class TagListComponent extends Component
{
    // Properties
    protected $tags = [];

    // Public method to get tags
    public function getTags()
    {
        return $this->tags;
    }

    // Public method to add a new tag
    public function storeTag($name)
    {
        if ($this->validate(['name' => 'required'])) {
            $tag = Tag::create([
                'name' => $name,
            ]);
            $this->tags[] = $tag;
        }
    }

    // Public method to delete a tag
    public function deleteTag($id)
    {
        if ($this->validate(['id' => 'required'])) {
            $tag = Tag::find($id);
            if ($tag) {
                $tag->delete();
                array_splice($this->tags, array_search($tag, $this->tags), 1);
            }
        }
    }

    // Public method to fetch tags from the database
    public function fetchTags()
    {
        $this->tags = Tag::all()->toArray();
    }

    // Render method
    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.tag-list-component');
    }
}
```
